event: Existing CI did not bind all eight quality dimensions to actual source-scoped command results.
pattern: A green narrow check can be mistaken for product readiness or fail to constrain a separate governance verdict.
structure: A pinned maintained runner executes actual declared checks; the authoritative reusable verdict consumes the actual validate job result and retains policy and secret scans.
archetype: Shifting the burden from observed system evidence to a single green indicator.
intervention: Declare source-bound checks, retain complete criteria and gaps, add semantic negative controls, and preserve human merge and existing operational boundaries.
leading_indicators: All declared check receipts succeed for the exact source revision.
Failed, cancelled and skipped validation cannot yield a successful authoritative verdict.
Readiness validation rejects partial and unverified dimensions.
transfer: Apply scoped acceptance and evidence accounting to other owned projects without equating synthetic CI with deployed operational outcomes.
